title: A hacker broke into John Deere and SharkNinja with an army of AI agents
summary: A hacker broke into more than 100 websites using an army of AI agents that mostly operated on their own, according to findings from the AI security firm Norforge. Though Norforge doesn't name the targets, Reuters reports that the victims included companies like John Deere, SharkN
reason: Item reports an AI-agent cyberattack on company websites (security incident). No rule covers it: not a named model release, not a research paper/benchmark, not financing/M&A/partnership/product launch, not policy action, and not an open-source tool release.
